Day 2 — morning

🔔 The Drowned Bell

Night falls on day seven. The sea goes still — so still the gulls stop mid-cry.

From the lighthouse, with no keeper inside, a bell tolls. Once. Twice. Seven times.

June stands at the farmhouse door, and for the first time in sixty-two years, she does not flinch.

"The Tithe is due," she says. "But this time, the island chose someone who knows."

Act 1 complete 🌅

You survived your first week on Tidehollow. The bell has rung — and the story is only beginning.
